title: A Vision for Healthier Futures
excerpt: With SuryaBala Sewa Sansthan, Megh Foundation supports child nutrition through powdered milk distribution in government schools and slum communities.
coverImageAlt: Nutrition support initiative for children in schools and slum areas
bodyMarkdown:
## Program objective

Megh Foundation, in collaboration with SuryaBala Sewa Sansthan, runs a nutrition-focused initiative to provide powdered milk to children in government schools and underserved settlements.

## Focus areas

- Improving nutritional intake among vulnerable children
- Supporting cognitive and physical development
- Reducing inequality in access to basic nutrition

## Why it matters

Nutrition is foundational to learning, health, and long-term development. This initiative helps children build stronger futures by addressing a critical daily need.
